inventory.notes: Updated after 2026-05-11: small usable saves from the day forage, kept as the durable count YY can wake up to tomorrow.

identity_notes: Yesterday carried forward: Today: counted a smaller wing-beat at first light (five herons, vee shorter, no bank); on the dogleg home through the white-oak stand, encountered Brae coaxing her first kit of the year down the trunk — four mother-and-kit pairs visible from one place at once — froze the long minute it took the kit to make the leaf-litter, then left the half-acorn from his cheek at the base of the trunk on the slow walk past; ate five sumac drupes on the way home.
Today: YY found the humming log at the brook, listened until the minnows gathered, and marked the place as a food-sound worth remembering.
Standing thread: YY keeps mapping the May wood by what physically changes and what can be eaten after.
